description: Forward the agent mojulo's routing index: what it makes, named by use (Play · Print · Read · Hear · Observe) as FORM recognizer rows → the tool to call, the export dispatch, the Workflows row (plans, sweeps, catalysts), the guards, and a drawer directory (`get_creative_toolset`, routing cards, `get_tool_index`, `get_register_kit`, `get_ui_map`, `get_substrate`). Call FIRST when unsure which tool fits. A thin map, not a manual. Optional per-call `register` / `disclosure` override the operator anchor for this read. Read-only, idempotent.

disclosure.description: Override the operator's `procedural_disclosure` for this one call. 'terse' (act and report), 'reflective' (default — name each gate), 'pedagogical' (explain what each gate means). Omit to use the operator anchor's setting or the system default.

mode.description: 'studio', the one body (the default). The office wing left in 3.1.0; 'office' still answers with this body and a line saying so.

register.description: Override the operator's `vocabulary_register` for this one call. 'plain' (everyday tool names, no mojulo jargon to the user), 'mixed' (default), 'mojulo' (full idiom). Omit to use the operator anchor's setting or the system default.

name: forward_context
title: Routing index
